title: Weinstein told the same by multiple unrelated parties

tellings.quote: So, I've been told the same thing by multiple parties who are not related.

plain: Eric Weinstein, a researcher and commentator who wants the Pentagon to release its UFO secrets, says that several people with no link to each other have all told him the same thing. He says it while pressing a Pentagon scientist on the show, though in what he says here he does not spell out what the shared claim was. His point is that matching accounts from unconnected sources are harder to brush aside.
